SIDDHESH R. BHAGAT Lead Software Developer / Team Lead

PROFILE

Lead Software Engineer/Team Lead (expertise - Java) with 8.4 years of experience working in various stages of software development life cycle like requirement analysis, effort estimation, proof of concept, design, development, and maintenance with proven skills in implementing creative solutions to customer problems. Adept at architecting scalable and reusable solutions, leading development and QA teams, and as a SPOC responsible for collaborating with stakeholders at all levels to ensure seamless communication and timely project deliveries.

WORK EXPERIENCE

TechBulls SoftTech Pvt. Ltd Team Lead

AprIl 2022 - Present

Working as the Lead Developer/Team Lead on a Loan Risk Management System for India’s largest public sector bank, used by 500+ banking officials to assess and manage corporate borrower risks. Implemented workflow automation, detailed MIS analytics, and risk-grade assessments to minimize loan defaults. Led a team of 6 members for a joint project between India’s largest payment gateway and India’s 2nd largest public sector bank to design and develop a contact fetch service with intelligent card blocking-unblocking (hard/soft), an admin dashboard with MFA & IP-based security, and an advanced MIS reporting module for banking teams. Successfully led a 30M+ card data migration within 12 hours. Designed and implemented high-performance utilites for card tokenisation to tokenise 50 million+ mandates on 30 million+ cards in production by integrating APIs from networks like VISA, Mastercard, AMEX and Diners.

Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices with Event-driven Architecture, PostgreSQL, Oracle 19c, Kafka, Docker, AWS, Git

TechBulls SoftTech Pvt. Ltd Senior Software Developer

July 2019 - April 2022

As a module lead - Architected and implemented a high-volume notification framework for India’s largest payment gateway, integrating with 40+ banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, etc.) using Kafka, Spring Boot, and Async HTTP, handling 50M+ notifications/month. Worked as the lead developer of life and health insurance verticals for a leading Indian insurance aggregator - Turtlemint. Successfully led developers from 2 teams to ensure timely quality deliveries to client.

Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices with Event-driven Architecture, PostgreSQL, Oracle 19c, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker, AWS, Git, React

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
TechBulls SoftTech Pvt. Ltd Team Lead
AprIl 2022 - Present
Working as the Lead Developer/Team Lead on a Loan Risk Management System for India’s largest public sector bank, used by 500+ banking officials to assess and manage corporate borrower risks. Implemented workflow automation, detailed MIS analytics, and risk-grade assessments to minimize loan defaults. Led a team of 6 members for a joint project between India’s largest payment gateway and India’s 2nd largest public sector bank to design and develop a contact fetch service with intelligent card blocking-unblocking (hard/soft), an admin dashboard with MFA & IP-based security, and an advanced MIS reporting module for banking teams. Successfully led a 30M+ card data migration within 12 hours. Designed and implemented high-performance utilites for card tokenisation to tokenise 50 million+ mandates on 30 million+ cards in production by integrating APIs from networks like VISA, Mastercard, AMEX and Diners.
Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices with Event-driven Architecture, PostgreSQL, Oracle 19c, Kafka, Docker, AWS, Git
TechBulls SoftTech Pvt. Ltd Senior Software Developer
July 2019 - April 2022
As a module lead - Architected and implemented a high-volume notification framework for India’s largest payment gateway, integrating with 40+ banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, etc.) using Kafka, Spring Boot, and Async HTTP, handling 50M+ notifications/month. Worked as the lead developer of life and health insurance verticals for a leading Indian insurance aggregator - Turtlemint. Successfully led developers from 2 teams to ensure timely quality deliveries to client.
Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices with Event-driven Architecture, PostgreSQL, Oracle 19c, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker, AWS, Git, React
TechBulls SoftTech Pvt. Ltd Software Developer Built a generic development efforts by atleast 60%. Lead and delivered end-to-end insurance integrations with top insurers - HDFC Ergo, ICICI Lombard, Max Bupa, HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential, Bajaj Allianz, Universal Sompo, and more. Used generic designs in the implementations, thus avoiding the use of any insurer-specific code.
